changelog:
Testing Build (vc21-0910) vs Testing Build (vc22-0910)

Changes

- New Update History in Settings > Update: a permanent per-device record of every update and rollback (collapsible section) - each entry shows from -> to, date, result (Done / Failed / In progress) and the expandable changelog of that version; entries are created when the attempt starts, finalized from the updater state (done, failed or interrupted) and capped at 50 on /sdcard so they survive updates and rollbacks. First boot with an empty history seeds a baseline entry from the rollback checkpoint so the transition update appears too.

- Rollback checkpoint window: the previous version is now kept for exactly 7 days - the panel shows the exact expiry date under the Rollback button and the server removes the checkpoint automatically afterwards (hourly sweep plus on every update check). Same window enforced on the rollback endpoint.

- Rollback polish: the button blinks once for 5 seconds whenever a NEW checkpoint appears (after an update, or when the previous one was replaced) and never again for the same checkpoint; the update and rollback progress logs no longer print internal directory paths - the DONE line simply points to Settings > Update for the 7-day rollback.
